findings.title: Players entering an interior or starting a race in Eye view cannot see or navigate it — the first-person canvas is never hidden when the render loop takes a non-campus branch
findings.observed: Party, office, cellar and race render behind a frozen fullscreen Eye view canvas.

findings.title: Standalone Crowd Control players still win with bystanders in the ring — the documented game's count only examines the original crowd
findings.observed: Standing bystanders inside the ring do not increase the remaining count.

findings.title: Standalone Crowd Control players still count people outside the marked oval — the documented game tests a circle rather than the drawn ellipse
findings.observed: A person inside radius 105 but outside the oval remains counted.

findings.title: Standalone Crowd Control players still cannot ask a returning person to leave — interaction only accepts the original crowd role which is cleared on the first request
findings.observed: Pressing E near a returning asked person does not ask them to move.

findings.title: Eye-view players are caught by invisible security and mission sentries — the 3D scene renders only NPCS and vehicles while the separate guard and sentry simulations still pursue and detect them
findings.observed: GUARDS and MX.sent continue detecting players but have no first-person meshes.

findings.title: Standalone players still drive buggies without night headlights or tail lights — the documented game's new night-light pass excludes buggy vehicles
findings.observed: The night-light vehicle loop skips type buggy even when it is being driven.

findings.title: Crowd Control players in Eye view cannot see the oval they must clear — the first-person scene replaces the canvas but never renders the mission ring
findings.observed: Eye view shows a gold marker but no Crowd Control ground ellipse.

findings.title: Landscape phone drivers lose the mission timer behind Next song — the new high-z-index radio button sits over the centered timer at common short screen heights
findings.observed: At 320px height the button spans y=70–114 over the centered mission timer.

findings.title: Players using Eye view lose rainy-night road reflections and other vehicles' lights — the new 3D renderer shows flat ground, bulbs and unlit vehicle boxes without the 2D light and shimmer pass
findings.observed: In Eye view rain only changes fog; lamp reflections and traffic lights are not rendered.

findings.title: Standalone players cannot select the requested Eye view — the documented game still has only the three original camera modes
findings.observed: The standalone camera cycles only Overview, Close and Follow.

findings.title: Standalone drivers cannot switch radio songs by button or R — the documented game's radio has no skip control or key binding
findings.observed: The standalone game has no R-key or button handler for skipping radio songs.

findings.title: Standalone players miss rainy-night lamp and headlight reflections — the documented game's night pass lacks the wet-road shimmer added to the served game
findings.observed: The standalone night pass draws fixed pools and beams without rain shimmer.

findings.title: A temporary radio load error still removes a song from The Terrace playlist — the changed radio handler permanently marks the shared song object bad
findings.observed: A car-radio audio error sets the shared song's bad flag for The Terrace too.

findings.title: Crowd Control players can repeatedly ask a sheltering bystander to move without clearing them — rain movement overrides the exit destination written by the new E interaction
findings.observed: During rain an asked NPC follows n.cover instead of the new 320-unit exit target.

findings.title: Eye-view players cannot see side-quest checkpoints, chai recipients or collectible stickers — the 3D renderer only creates main-mission markers and hides the 2D quest graphics
findings.observed: The Eye view renders no side-quest Yulu gates, chai markers or sticker meshes.

findings.title: Players cannot reframe photos in Eye view — photo controls move the 2D camera while the visible 3D camera remains fixed at the player
findings.observed: Photo-mode input changes cam.x/y but Eye view always looks from S.px/py.

findings.title: Players cannot try Eye view again after a temporary load or graphics initialization failure — the failure state permanently suppresses fppLoad until the whole page is reloaded
findings.observed: A single script or WebGL setup failure sets FPP.st=-1 and prevents another load.

findings.title: Drivers on a stalled song load can lose both radio audio and normal campus music for the ride — radioOn ducks immediately and has no timeout for a play promise that never settles
findings.observed: A pending play() leaves RADIO.on true and music ducked without a playing event.

findings.title: Drivers see the radio button over photos and pause screens — its fixed z-index exceeds those overlays and it is not hidden in photo mode
findings.observed: Next song remains visible over the photo frame and above the pause overlay.
